related_keywords.title: Kirby Problem 2.10
related_keywords.statement:
(a) Is there an efficient algorithm to compute distances in the curve complex
of a surface? The input to the algorithm should be the surface and the
curves. One may ask similar questions for related complexes, such as the
arc complex of a surface with boundary.
(b) Is there an algorithm (efficient or otherwise) to compute the distance be-
tween quasi-convex subsets of the curve complex? This question is partic-
ularly interesting in the case where the quasi-convex subsets are the disk
sets of handlebodies.

related_keywords.title: Random-walk displacement exponent on the UIPT
related_keywords.statement: For simple random walk $(X_n)$ on the uniform infinite planar triangulation, prove that the graph distance from the starting point has exponent $1/4$, in the sense that $d_{\mathrm{gr}}(X_0,X_n)\asymp n^{1/4}$ up to the intended subpolynomial or constant factors.

related_keywords.title: Circle-packing measure of uniform random triangulations
related_keywords.statement: Let $T_n$ be a uniform triangulation of the sphere with $n$ faces, normalize its circle packing by its conformal barycenter, and let $\mu_{P T_n}$ be the empirical measure of tangency points. Determine the support dimension and singularity of subsequential limits $\mu_\infty$; prove uniqueness in law; identify any relation to the Gaussian free field and KPZ; and determine how $\mu_\infty$ relates to the limiting random metric $d_\infty$.

related_keywords.title: Percolation threshold of fast-growing planar triangulations
related_keywords.statement: Let $G$ be a planar triangulation with uniform volume growth faster than quadratic. Must $p_c(G)<1$? More strongly, is $p_c(G)=1/2$?

related_keywords.title: Binary trees in critical clusters of regular planar triangulations
related_keywords.statement: Let $H_k$ be a $k$-regular planar triangulation. At the critical percolation parameter for the event that an open cluster contains a full infinite binary tree, prove that the event has positive probability.

related_keywords.title: Half-density percolation on transient disk triangulations
related_keywords.statement: Let $G$ be the one-skeleton of a bounded-degree triangulation of an open disk. If $G$ is transient, prove that Bernoulli site percolation with parameter $1/2$ has an infinite cluster almost surely.

related_keywords.title: Critical probability of polynomial-growth disk triangulations
related_keywords.statement: Let $G$ be a bounded-degree triangulation of an open disk with polynomial volume growth. Prove that its Bernoulli site-percolation critical probability satisfies $p_c(G)\ge 1/2$. Under natural sparsity hypotheses on vertices of degree greater than six, is $p_c(G)=1/2$?

related_keywords.title: Recurrence versus half-density percolation in disk triangulations
related_keywords.statement: Let $G$ be the one-skeleton of a bounded-degree recurrent triangulation of an open disk. Prove that Bernoulli site percolation with parameter $1/2$ has no infinite cluster.

related_keywords.title: Infinitely many clusters at half density on transient disk triangulations
related_keywords.statement: Let $G$ be the one-skeleton of a bounded-degree transient triangulation of an open disk. Prove that Bernoulli site percolation with parameter $1/2$ has infinitely many infinite clusters almost surely.

related_keywords.title: Local metric homogeneity forcing periodic triangulations
related_keywords.statement: Let the Euclidean plane or hyperbolic plane have a triangulation whose triangles have diameter at most $r$. Suppose that for every pair of radius-$r$ metric balls centered at vertices, an ambient isometry maps one ball to the other while respecting the triangulation. Must the triangulation be periodic?

related_keywords.title: Resistance growth on the UIPT
related_keywords.statement: Determine the almost-sure asymptotic growth rate of the effective resistance from the root to graph-distance $r$ in the uniform infinite planar triangulation.

related_keywords.title: Linear support of harmonic measure in recurrent planar triangulations
related_keywords.statement: Let $G$ be a bounded-degree recurrent planar triangulation with a fixed root. Are there arbitrarily large $r$ and finite domains containing the radius-$r$ ball such that at least $1-o(1)$ of harmonic measure on the domain boundary is supported on only $r^{1+o(1)}$ boundary circles in the circle packing? Does this hold at least under unimodularity, and in particular for the UIPT?

related_keywords.title: Isoperimetric bounds for critical probabilities of disk triangulations
related_keywords.statement: Let $G$ be a bounded-degree triangulation of a disk. Prove that each of the following conditions implies $p_c(G)\le1/2$: $\operatorname{Dim}(G)\ge2$; $\operatorname{Dim}(G)>1$; or $|\partial A|\ge f(|A|)\log|A|$ for every finite vertex set $A$, where $f(n)\to\infty$. Moreover, prove that $h(G)>0$ implies $p_c(G)<1/2$.

related_keywords.title: Vanishing Normalized Homology Under Local Manifold Convergence
related_keywords.statement:
Let $d\geq3$, and let $(M_n)$ be triangulated compact $d$-manifolds whose triangulation $1$-skeleta have uniformly bounded vertex degrees and which Benjamini–Schramm converge to a triangulation of $\mathbb R^d$. Is

$$\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{\dim H_1(M_n)}{|M_n|}=0$$?
